message: I've always found that a little power outage can lead to some surprisingly delightful moments. It's a chance to rediscover low-tech fun—think board games, candlelit dinners, or even just stargazing in the backyard! I came across a great resource that offers tips for preparing for power outages, which is a clever way to embrace these unexpected breaks. Have you ever enjoyed a blackout? What low-tech activities do you love to do?
